text:
zoe: Heads-up: small blast of out-of-band updates started at 00:42Z in eu-west. Seeing a handful of nodes drop NVMe and GPUs get reclaimed mid-run.

kai: Inspecting logs: several boards show a transient RTC/clock jump during BMC activation which correlates with a secboot enforcement flip on apply. That seems to force a bus reenumeration and we get PCIe retrain + nvme resets.

sre-jas: Repro on a bench canary with the same image: after activation the slot 0/1 link goes through retrain and NVMe controller reports "reset due to link state change".

infra-oncall: Pausing the remaining racks in eu-west and eu-central. deploy-bot: pause requested.

deploy-bot: rollout "oob-bmc-2026-03-21-v2" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 00:58Z.

zoe: Can we avoid immediate power-cycles? Those can cause longer customer-visible downtime. Prefer remote flash revert if possible.

ops-maya: Starting targeted reflash to prior signed image on r07-02. Command:
```
ssh jump-r07
sudo bmcctl flash --image s3://fw-artifacts/bmc-2026-02-11-signed.bin --rack r07-02 --no-wipe --reboot
bmcctl ntp-sync --rack r07-02
watch -n 5 bmc-health --rack r07-02 | egrep "AER|nvme|pci"
```

kai: Also check BMC time before flashing; if time skew >1.5s the activation path can behave inconsistently and flip attributes partially.

sre-jas: Short-term cluster config: increase kubelet eviction grace to 9m for eu-west inference pools and freeze scale-in to avoid reschedule storms.

finance-ron: FYI budget owners: holding pools and extended canaries will likely add ~70-120 GPU-hours if this lasts >12h. Notifying the billing team.

ops-maya: Reflash done on r07-02; 25m smoke shows NVMe stable and GPUs remain allocated under stress test. No further PCIe retrains in logs.

kai: Proposed deploy change: add preflight gate in the rollout pipeline to verify BMC NTP (<1s), zero PCIe retrains in last 24h, and NVMe AER counters within normal bounds before allowing rack apply. Also increase canary observation to 60m.

zoe: Agreed. Postmortem owners: kai + ops-maya. Immediate actions: pause rollout (done), targeted revert (done for r07-02), autoscaler hold (done), finance notified (done). Will update #incidents in 30m with customer impact. :thumbsup:
